articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: How The Illinois Tool Works (ITW) Story Is Shifting As Analysts Rework Price Targets. Price targets for Illinois Tool Works are being adjusted in both directions, with bullish analysts lifting their views by about US$5 to US$35, while more cautious voices trim theirs by roughly US$24 to US$25. These moves reflect a debate you should be aware of, as some firms focus on AI related risks to high margin hardware, while others highlight room for execution on long term plans and a valuation reset.
